Privacy

Privacy notice

Last updated: 22 September 2026

FendousBio.ai is an informational website. We do not use analytics, advertising trackers, contact forms, or non-essential cookies.

Who is responsible?

Fendous Sustainable Solutions ApS, Aalborg, Denmark, is responsible for the personal data described here. Contact: contact@fendousbio.ai.

Hosting and technical logs

The website is hosted by Netlify. When you visit, technical information such as IP address, browser information, requested pages, timestamps, and security events may be processed in hosting and security logs. This supports secure and reliable delivery and is based on our legitimate interest in operating and protecting the site.

Email contact

If you email us, we process the information you provide—such as name, email address, organization, and message—to respond and manage the resulting professional relationship. Email is handled through Google Workspace.

Cookies and analytics

We do not intentionally set analytics, advertising, or other non-essential cookies, and we do not use visitor profiling. Essential infrastructure may process limited technical data required to deliver and secure the website.

Service providers

Technical and contact data may be processed by providers supporting hosting and email under their contractual and legal safeguards. We do not sell personal data.

Retention

Technical logs follow the hosting provider's operational and security settings. Email is retained only as long as reasonably necessary for the enquiry, professional relationship, documentation, or applicable legal requirements.

Your rights

Subject to applicable law, you may request access, correction, deletion, restriction, objection, or data portability. You may also complain to the Danish Data Protection Agency (Datatilsynet).
